meta.title: 30块和80块的理发师，到底差在哪？五条清单
meta.title_en: 30-Yuan vs 80-Yuan Barbers: What's the Real Difference?

scenes.context: 讲者通过楼下开理发店的阿姨问出30块和80块理发师的差别，先给出手艺判断和学徒练手提醒。
sentences: 30块和80块的托尼老师，到底有没有区别？
Is there really a difference between a 30-yuan and an 80-yuan barber?
托尼老师：barber
对发型没有要求的普通男士，30块和80块剪出来的基本一致。
For an average guy who doesn't care much about his hair, the two cuts come out basically the same.
基本一致：basically the same
看到理发店搞超低价活动，比如79块钱三次，就是学徒练手。
Spot a super-cheap deal, like 79 yuan for three visits — that's trainees practicing on you.
学徒练手：trainees practicing
paraphrase: 价格差是否值，取决于你在意发型
Whether the price gap is worth it depends on how much you care.
贪便宜=把脑袋借给学徒
Chasing the low price means lending your head to a trainee.
scenes.speak: Is there really a difference between a 30-yuan and an 80-yuan barber? For an average guy who doesn't care much about his hair, the two cuts come out basically the same. Spot a super-cheap deal, like 79 yuan for three visits — that's trainees practicing on you.

scenes.title_cn: 不会货不对板，贵在时尚感知
scenes.title_en: No bait-and-switch; you pay for style sense
scenes.context: 讲者解释高价不会货不对板，并点出高价理发师强在时尚感知。
sentences: 付了80块剪到30块，理发店不会砸自己的招牌。
Pay 80 and get a 30-yuan cut? The shop won't risk its own reputation.
砸招牌：risk its reputation
80块和100块以上的托尼老师不拿基本工资，所以宁可闲着也不听你剪。
Barbers charging 80 or 100 yuan get no base salary, so they'd rather sit idle than take your cheap cut.
宁可闲着：would rather sit idle
课单价高的托尼会买时尚杂志研究，会刷抖音看大师级托尼是怎么剪的。
High-priced barbers buy fashion magazines, and watch master barbers cut on Douyin.
时尚感知：sense of style
paraphrase: 价格对应排他配置，不是玄学
Price reflects who you can buy, not magic.
Every snip carries years of practice.
scenes.speak: Pay 80 and get a 30-yuan cut? The shop won't risk its own reputation. Barbers charging 80 or 100 yuan get no base salary, so they'd rather sit idle than take your cheap cut. High-priced barbers buy fashion magazines, and watch master barbers cut on Douyin.

scenes.title_en: The shop makes money on perms and dyes
scenes.context: 讲者揭示理发店真实利润来源：烫染药水差价，毛利率翻10倍不止。
sentences: 即使剪头发30块80块，其实赚不到你的钱。
Even at 30 or 80 yuan a cut, they barely make money off you.
赚不到你的钱：barely make money
真正赚钱的是烫发和染发，药水的毛利率翻10倍可能都不止。
The real money is in perms and dyes — the chemical markup can be ten times or more.
毛利率：profit margin
老板会告诉你好的药水价格自然贵，但他不会告诉你药水的毛利率。
The boss will say premium chemicals cost more, but won't tell you the actual margin.
药水差价：chemical markup
paraphrase: 剪发是引子，烫染才是生意
Cuts are the hook; perms and dyes are the business.
Premium chemicals don't mean fair pricing.
scenes.speak: Even at 30 or 80 yuan a cut, they barely make money off you. The real money is in perms and dyes — the chemical markup can be ten times or more. The boss will say premium chemicals cost more, but won't tell you the actual margin.

practice: I don't care much about my hair.
The shop won't risk its reputation.
The chemical markup can be ten times or more.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The barber's level is not the same.
✓ 地道说法：There's a real skill gap between them.
✕ 直译腔：They use your head to practice.
✓ 地道说法：They're training on your head.
✕ 直译腔：The shop won't smash its own brand card.
✓ 地道说法：The shop won't risk its own reputation.
✕ 直译腔：The gross profit rate is ten times.
✓ 地道说法：The markup can be ten times or more.

想到超低价可能是学徒练手
以为理发店靠剪发赚钱
看穿烫染药水的差价逻辑
